categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Longli Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the LED backlight display module industry, focusing on providing integrated backlight display module solutions. Its core business segments include consumer electronics (mobile phones, tablets, notebooks), rapidly growing automotive display business, and emerging businesses such as LIPO technology for OLED displays and new intelligent hardware terminals including AR/VR displays and precision structural components. The company follows a '1+2+N' diversified business layout emphasizing these areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including ultra-thin and ultra-high brightness LGP compression molding, ultra-short optical path backlight modules, line light source (COB) backlight modules, and shaped backlight modules. It actively invests in Mini-LED and Micro-LED technologies, with Mini-LED products already in mass production for automotive and VR applications. The company also innovates in OLED-related LIPO ultra-narrow bezel technology to enhance structural strength and sealing. Production is customized and batch-based, driven by sales orders, supported by ERP and quality control systems, and integrates intelligent manufacturing with SAP, MES, BI, and WMS systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading LCD display module manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers such as BOE, TCL Huaxing, Changxin, and others, as well as automotive Tier 1 suppliers like Continental, Faurecia, Visteon, and end customers including BYD, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, SAIC, Geely, and international brands like Ford, Toyota, Hyundai, and Meta. The company serves markets in consumer electronics, automotive intelligent displays, VR/AR devices, and emerging smart hardware sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Mainland China with manufacturing bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Xiamen, and overseas subsidiaries in India. Its sales are predominantly domestic (over 94%) with a smaller but growing export portion (around 6%). Major sales regions within China include North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Longli Technology operates in the midstream segment of the LED industry supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of backlight display modules. It integrates upstream component processing such as precision molds, metal stamping, and optical injection molding, and serves downstream display module manufacturers and Tier 1 customers, providing customized backlight solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology-driven innovation with significant R&D investment in Mini-LED, Micro-LED, and OLED LIPO technologies. It focuses on enhancing Mini-LED cost-effectiveness and performance, advancing Micro-LED commercialization, and improving OLED ultra-narrow bezel processes. Additionally, it invests in new intelligent hardware components like AI glasses and AR optical systems. The company holds over 543 patents, including 155 invention patents, and actively participates in industry standard development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of backlight display modules and related products to LCD display module manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers. The company recognizes revenue upon customer acceptance or usage under vendor-managed inventory agreements. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on product sales and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longli Technology is positioned as a leading domestic player in the backlight display module industry in China, competing with companies like Ruijie Optoelectronics, Japan Minebea Group, Dongguan Sanxie Precision Technology, Weizhi Holdings, Baoming Technology, and Nanjiguang Electronics. It holds a strong competitive edge in Mini-LED automotive backlight technology and is recognized for its quality and innovation capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.32 billion, representing a 28.64% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 106.38 million, a 132.9% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.98 billion, growing 10.48% from the previous year. Operating cash flow improved significantly with a net inflow of RMB 347.65 million. The company maintains a positive growth trajectory with expanding automotive and new technology business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Longli Technology emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, including ultra-thin, high-brightness, narrow bezel backlight modules and leading Mini-LED and Micro-LED innovations. Its integrated intelligent manufacturing capabilities and strong R&D pipeline enable customized, high-quality solutions that meet stringent automotive and consumer electronics standards. The company’s stable and high-quality customer base, coupled with its participation in industry standards, reinforces its market leadership and ability to deliver cutting-edge display solutions.
